questions.question: How does your skin feel 2-3 hours after cleansing (no products)?

options.text: Generally comfortable but showing fine lines

questions.question: How does your skin react to new products?

options.text: Often gets red, stings, or irritated
T-zone might break out, cheeks stay calm
Takes longer to see results, focuses on anti-aging
Different issues in different face zones

questions.question: How does your skin look without makeup?

options.text: Mixed - some areas shiny, others normal
Shows signs of aging but generally even

routines.Oily/Acne-Prone:
• Gentle cleanser 2x daily (avoid over-cleansing!).
• Use niacinamide serums to control oil production.
• Non-comedogenic moisturizers are your friend.
• Clay masks 1-2x weekly for deep cleansing.
routines.Dry/Sensitive:
• Cream-based cleansers and rich moisturizers.
• Hyaluronic acid serums for hydration boost.
• Avoid fragrances and harsh actives.
• Use facial oils as the last step in your routine.
routines.Combination Skin:
• Multi-zone approach: lighter products on T-zone.
• BHA for oily areas, gentle hydration for dry zones.
• Use different masks on different face areas.
• Gentle exfoliation 2x weekly.
routines.Mature/Aging Skin:
• Retinol products (start slow, build tolerance).
• Vitamin C serums for antioxidant protection.
• Rich, peptide-infused moisturizers.
• Never skip SPF - it's your best anti-aging tool!
